mainEntity.name: What to Ask Before Hiring a Kitchen Remodeling Contractor
mainEntity.text: What to Ask Before Hiring a Kitchen Remodeling Contractor

acceptedAnswer.text:
When planning a major kitchen remodel, homeowners often wonder how to verify that a contractor has the depth and accountability to carry the job from concept to completion. You want a crew with proven local project management, proper protection, and clear communication.

Questions to Ask Before You Decide
First, ask to see proof of active insurance, bonding, and workers' compensation coverage to protect your home. Second, ask for a detailed written scope of work that itemizes labor, cabinetry materials, and specific change-order procedures so there are no surprise costs later. Third, ask how mechanical trades are handled; quality remodelers partner with fully licensed and insured subcontractors for specialized plumbing and electrical work. Finally, ask for references from recent local projects and inquire specifically about schedule adherence and daily communication.

A well-planned renovation should give you confidence at every stage, from initial design concepts to final trim.
